messages.subject: Rasch model after 2PLM
parts:
Hi phil

please I have a question about exploratory and confirmatory irt models: is it possible to use the 2-PLM to select items and assess dimensionality for an exploratory purpose  and then in a second phase use the Rasch model for a confirmatory purpose .

Thanks a lot for your help

Makram.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Rasch model after 2PLM
parts:
Yes that's one decent approach. You'll also want to include item/model fit statistics when pruning for Rasch items. Ultimately the best was to test your new Rasch tests is to cross-validate the test on a new sample, so if that's part of your research program then you are well off.

Phil
